rootCause: On Nov 14th 2020 at 03:36:30 PM UTC, a hacker performed a flash-loan exploit on the MultiStables vault of ValueDeFi protocol, which resulted in a net loss of roughly 6mil$. - Value DeFi on Twitter: "The MultiStables vault was the subject of a complex attack that resulted in a net loss of $6M. https://t.co/dnFRa5yPBJ We are currently working on a postmortem and are exploring ways to mitigate the impact on our users." / Twitter - Defi Protocol That Bragged About Having Flash Loan Attack Prevention Hacked for $6 Million – Bitcoin News - MultiStables Vault Exploit Post-Mortem - by Value DeFi Protocol - Medium - Ethereum Transaction Hash (Txhash) Details -…
